capabilities: Create a new paragraph with a single Enter press
Keep default soft line breaks inside lists and code blocks
extras: The manifest carries the standard notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: In default Obsidian, one Enter only creates a soft line break, so users must press Enter twice to start a new paragraph.
summary: Editing-behavior plugin that makes a single Enter keypress insert a new paragraph instead of a soft line break.
